notes.title: Update Notes For Version 2.0.0.3
notes.content: -Fixed bug where screen could be offset wrong on certain transitions in two player mode.

notes.title: CometStriker DX Release!
notes.content:
[h2][b]CometStriker DX has now released as a free update![/b][/h2]

The game now includes [b]two player local coop[/b] and a [b]new challenge mode[/b] with over fifty unique bite-sized challenge levels!

Check it out!

------------------------
[h3]Changelog:[/h3]
-Added challenge mode.
-Added two player local coop.
-Adjusted Lt. Striker's character graphics.
-Added "Classic Lt. Striker" option in extras menu for those who want the old character graphics.
-Adjusted Lt. Striker's shot damage/rate/fire.
-Refined analog movement.
-Reduced various explosions hitbox sizes to better match graphic.
-Disabled screen shake on a certain character's bullet explosion.
-Adjusted Scorpiod, Knight Beetle, and Super Squire Beetle on very hard difficulty.
-Adjusted hitbox on Fungi.
-Adjusted Launcher Crab boss on very hard difficulty.
-Adjusted Reanimator boss on hard and very hard difficulty.
-Bomber parasite explodes on player contact now no matter what.
-Added tell for Strider dash speed.
-Fixed Labyrinth mode not being consistent across multiple platforms.
-Gravity Antlion now has an intro animation.
-Added "Restore Defaults" button to options menu that will restore default settings.

------------------------
[h3]Note:[/h3]
[i]64-bit is required for CometStriker DX. Players with 32-bit computers will not receive this update.[/i]
